plan.design: Paired 3-fold grouped development comparison on the freshly verified subset of the original 453 target development events. Both arms see identical freshly audited validation-pad features. Baseline is refit using recorded current-training features; candidates train only freshly audited photos. Original 112 confirmation events and related known groups/tokens excluded. Fixed current per-analyte k, metric and transform. No hyperparameter or confidence-threshold search.
plan.additions: Supplied, complete, non-conflicting specimen references and audited geometry only. Byte/pixel duplicate exports and chart/binary conversions excluded. Same held-out target-group numerical IDs/subject aliases are conservatively excluded from extra-data training across batches.
plan.identity_limit: Cross-batch participant identity remains unverified; this is retrospective exploratory development, not a new untouched final evaluation.
plan.promotion: Accuracy/macro F1/macro sensitivity/macro specificity and supported rule sensitivity/specificity must not decrease; macro F1 must improve; paired group bootstrap lower accuracy delta must exceed zero. Combined whole-ten accuracy, feature-stage retake coverage and accepted-all-ten accuracy must not regress. Engineering comparison only, not a clinical safety threshold.

accuracy_delta.method: paired percentile bootstrap of within-batch groups, 2000 resamples; provisional identities
